verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA H200 is a data-center GPU, and user-facing bulk operations across many items (bulk edit or bulk actions in an app or API) are a wrong axis for this kind of product. The evidence covers memory, throughput, MIG partitioning and CUDA libraries. Nothing shows the product ships a bulk-operations feature, and parallel compute or data-processing libraries are a different capability, not bulk item management.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
